items.information:
## Information

[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024! This competition has a full array of blindfolded events, with Clock and 5x5 to mix things up. 
Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. **Important** - if we do not have enough competitors to hold 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, we will adjust the schedule to have 2 Rounds of 5x5 instead.

**PLEASE NOTE** This competition does NOT have 3x3 or other popular events like 2x2 or Pyraminx. If you are a newcomer, please do not register unless you are able to solve cubes Blindfolded or would like to participate in the 5x5 or Clock events.

## SPECTATORS

Spectators are only allowed as companions to competitors.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with **volunteering** during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler".

If any competitor or competitor's guests are willing to help judge with the blindfolded events, especially Multiple Blindfolded, please let us know. If you are able to assist with judging the longer events (4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and Multiple Blindfolded), we will reward you with a free coffee, chocolate, or other small gift :)

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you are able to assist in any way and want to get involved, please get in touch [here](https://cubingza.org/contact)!

*  This is the second speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Nuuk!
*  The competition happens on Sunday June 23rd but a workshop will happen on Saturday 22nd from 16 to 19. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Sunday afternoon!
*  The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png)

Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Periusinik nutaanik ilinniarit, imminullu piffissalersornissannut  sapaammi.
*  Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit piffissalersussaatit, pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu peerpata sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnera unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissikkumaarlugu. *  Dette er den anden speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i Nuuk!
*  Konkurrencen finder sted søndag den 23. juni om eftermiddagen kl.13:10-19:45 , før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop lørdag den 22. fra kl. 16-19 og søndag fra kl.12-13. items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024!
Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. 
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. 
Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj.
Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt.

Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte!

Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet.

Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). 

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2024!
Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience.
You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. 
There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories.
The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt.

Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts!

There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. 

If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

*  This is the first speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Ilulissat!
*  The competition happens on Saturday 15 June in the afternoon (13 to 16), but a workshop will happen the morning (9 ti 12) and the day before, Friday 14 from 13 to 17. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Saturday afternoon!
*  The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png)

* Una Ilulissani speedcubingimik unammisitsineq siullerpaajuvoq World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaq!
*  Unammineq arfininngornermi 15. juni ualikkut nal. 13:00-16:00 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq tallimanngornermi 14. juni nal. 13:00-17:00 aamma arfininngornermi 15. juni nal. 09:00-12:00 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Arfininngornermi ualikkut periutsinik nutaanik ilinniarnissannut nuannersumut peqatigisigut Cube-ertartut allat peqatigalugit, imminullu time-lersornermut piareersarlutit.
*  Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit aggeqqutissaatit piffissalersussallutillu, angusanni pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu ilanngaatigeriarlugit sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnerat unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissinneqarumaarpoq. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terning-ip naammassisinnaanngornissaa, tamanna pillugu pikkorissanermi ikiorumaarpatsigit.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png)

*  Dette er den første speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i ilulissat!
*  Konkurrencen finder sted lørdag den 15. juni om eftermiddagen kl. 13:00-16:00, før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop fredag den 14. fra kl. 13:00-17:00 og lørdag fra kl. 09:00-12:00. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv lørdag eftermiddag.
*  Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Big & Blind Pretoria 2024! This competition is focused on the the bigger NxNs like 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 and blind events!

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler".

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

# **SeaHorse Vallarta 2024**

**Español**

¡Bienvenidos a SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, la primera competencia celebrada en Puerto Vallarta! Es un honor darles la bienvenida a este emocionante evento donde los aficionados al cubo de Rubik de diversas partes del país podran convivir en este bello puerto y poder demostrar sus habilidades y rapidez.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**Ingles**
¡Welcome to SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, the first competition held in Puerto Vallarta! It is an honor to welcome you to this exciting event where Rubik Cube fans from different parts of the country will be able to coexist in this beautiful port and demonstrate their skills and speed.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
